data.short_description: Bayocean Oyster House is a waterside restaurant, seafood market, and processing dock concept from Oregon-born chef Jacob Harth. It is set to open at 1985 Bayocean Road NW in Tillamook in spring 2027, restoring a historic oyster processing facility. The menu will center on local oysters, grilled fish, and coastal species including a bisque made from invasive green crabs harvested from Tillamook Bay.

Local Ocean Seafoods is a seafood restaurant in Newport where chef Jacob Harth is currently running a chef residency. Harth is serving shellfish trays and raw preparations at 213 SE Bay Blvd as a preview of the Bayocean Oyster House concept. The residency is described as the best current way to experience Harth's coast-to-table cooking style.

Flip The Bird is a fried chicken chain known for sandwiches, biscuits, waffles, and comfort food. The Swampscott location permanently closed last week after the lease expired, with the team announcing on June 19 they would not renew. Rising construction costs, rent increases, operating expenses, and higher food prices were cited as reasons for the closure.

Nikki C's Bar and Grill is an Italian cuisine restaurant founded in 2004 that served the Pasadena community for 22 years. The restaurant permanently closed after structural roof failure in November 2025 made reopening unfeasible, with the team confirming on June 21, 2026 that it will not reopen. Ongoing regulatory obstacles related to parking loss and the building's condition prevented the owners from rebuilding.

Dolly's Tennessean Travel Stop is a travel center offering dining, retail, entertainment, and hospitality developed through a partnership between Dolly Parton, Danny Nozell, and Gregory H. Sachs. It is scheduled to open June 24 at 2:30 p.m. at 3686 Pulaski Highway in Cornersville, with opening celebrations running June 24 to July 3. The concept is a rebrand of The Tennessean Travel Stop, which has been operating since 1974, and will feature DLY BBQ, a general store, live music stage, and the debut of Parton's new coffee brand Cup of Ambition.

Luna Grill is a Mediterranean restaurant chain founded in 2004 in San Diego offering flame-grilled kabobs, bowls, salads, wraps, and pitas. The new location at 3921 Gaston Avenue in Dallas will open on June 25, marking the brand's 60th restaurant and ninth in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Special promotions through its Club Luna loyalty app and free hats and bowls will be offered to celebrate the opening.

Pizzeria Sei is a Tokyo-style Neapolitan pizza restaurant founded by Chef William (Sang Woo) Joo and his wife and business partner Jennifer So. The second location is scheduled to open on June 24, 2026 at 10700 Tabor Street in the Palms neighborhood of West Los Angeles. The new location offers expanded indoor seating, an expanded menu, a broader wine selection, and space for catering and private events.

Raising Cane's is a chicken finger restaurant chain that has opened its first California Flagship Restaurant at 3895 W. Century Blvd. in Hollywood Park, Inglewood, directly across from Intuit Dome. The multi-story, stadium-inspired restaurant features a 106-by-108-foot oval halo, LED displays, and a walk-up ordering window off Century Blvd. The flagship location includes a Disco Dog sculpture crafted from more than 185,000 mirrored tiles, created in collaboration with California-based artist Sofie Berarducci.

The Addison is a modern cocktail bar, sports lounge, and supper club at 214 W 39th Street in Midtown Manhattan, spanning 2,300 sq ft with seating for up to 120 guests. The venue is now open, offering specialty cocktails priced $18–20, draft and bottled beers, wines, and an elevated American food menu. It was created by hospitality veterans Ian Magid, Michael Shalev, and Anthony Barton in collaboration with NexHos Hospitality.

Palladino's Steak & Seafood is a modern steakhouse featuring prime cuts, seafood, Italian-inspired dishes, and refined sushi, debuting in Dallas's Preston Hollow neighborhood. The restaurant is set to open at 5959 Royal Lane, a homecoming for restaurateur Joseph Palladino who previously co-founded Nick & Sam's in Dallas. The Dallas location was designed by Rockwell Group and is led by Executive Chef Hazen and local Chef de Cuisine Henry Johnson.

data.status: will close at the end of the month
data.short_description: Blue Tuba is a Euro-Tex fusion restaurant operated by Czech natives Vlado Kolenic and Giga Leszayova that opened in May 2024 at the former Harold's in the Heights space. The restaurant is expected to close by the end of the month after roughly two years in business, with no official reason given by the restaurant for the closure. Houston-based singer David LaDuca announced the closure on social media, noting he will perform Saturdays and Sunday brunches during the restaurant's final weeks.

data.location: 800 Gateway Blvd, South San Francisco, CA 94080
data.short_description: Omakase World Market is an approximately 50,000-square-foot all-day dining hub from the Omakase Restaurant Group, featuring six distinct gourmet offerings under one roof at 800 Gateway Blvd on the Gateway of Pacific campus. The market is now open and marks the first time the Omakase Restaurant Group has brought multiple dining concepts together in a single destination. Amenities include a pool table, golf simulator, arcade games, a fitness center, and a wellness spa with red light therapy and sauna.

data.location: 102 W. Grand Parkway S., Suite 100, Katy, TX 77494
data.status: will open its doors on June 24
data.short_description: Aga's To Go is a new 4,300-square-foot takeout-focused concept from Aga's Restaurant & Catering, a family-owned Houston business expanding for the first time in 25 years. The new location will open on June 24 at The Shoppes at Grand Crossing development at 102 W. Grand Parkway S., Suite 100 in Katy, between Interstate 10 and the Grand Parkway. Aga's has been named No. 1 on the Houston Chronicle's Top 100 Restaurants list and has also appeared on Yelp's Top 100 Restaurants list.

data.location: Centennial Yards' Entertainment District, Atlanta, GA
data.short_description: Varuni Napoli is a local pizzeria known for its 900-degree wood-fired ovens and signature pies including Margherita Pizza, Bastardo, and house-made Cannoli. The pizzeria plans to open its fourth location in Centennial Yards' Entertainment District in Atlanta, with an expected opening in 2028. No specific address has been announced.

data.status: expanding its presence with another opening
data.short_description: Slutty Vegan is an Atlanta-based plant-based burger chain known for its Slut Sauce and signature burgers including the One Night Stand and Sloppy Toppy. A new Atlanta location will be operated by franchisees Khadejah Davis and Jamel Douglas, with no address or opening date yet announced. No further location details are provided in the article.

Bar Belle is a new cocktail bar concept from Chef Joey Ward planned to open at CTR Food Works in Atlanta. Both Bar Belle and Southern Belle Chicken Co. are expected to debut this summer at CTR Food Works, with no specific address announced. Bar Belle will feature cocktails, raw bar items, and a signature A-Town Burger.

Southern Belle Chicken Co. is a new fast-casual counter concept from Chef Joey Ward planned to open inside CTR Food Works in Atlanta. The concept is expected to debut this summer alongside Bar Belle, with no specific address announced. Southern Belle Chicken Co. will offer a chicken-focused menu at the counter inside CTR Food Works.

data.status: served its final meal on June 20
data.short_description: Townhouse Restaurant is a full-service California comfort food restaurant located in a nearly 100-year-old building at 5862 Doyle Street in Emeryville that operated for more than 36 years. The restaurant served its final meal on June 20, 2026, with ongoing financial pressures and an inability to secure financing cited as factors behind the closure. The building reportedly operated as a speakeasy in the 1920s before becoming Vernetti's Town House in the 1930s, and was reopened as Townhouse in 1990 by Chef Ellen Hope Rosenberg and Joseph Le Brun.

The Historic Highland Road Grill is a new Louisiana cuisine restaurant concept from owner Will "Willie" Chapman, owner of Willie's Restaurant, planned for the former Sammy's Grill space on Highland Road in Baton Rouge. Chapman expects to receive the keys on July 1 and is targeting an October opening for the 8,300-square-foot location at 8635 Highland Road. The menu is still being developed but will include crawfish and Louisiana seafood dishes.

Eataly is an Italian marketplace chain pursuing a new DMV-area location at Tysons Corner Center, where buildout permits were approved in late May 2026. The 23,000-square-foot space at 1961 Chain Bridge Road is the former site of an American Girl store, for which demolition permits have been issued. Representatives from Eataly and Tysons Corner Center have declined to officially confirm the new location.

American Girl is a retail store that previously occupied a two-story space at 1961 Chain Bridge Road in Tysons Corner Center. Demolition permits for the former American Girl space have been issued by Fairfax County to allow for Eataly's planned buildout. No closure date for the American Girl store is specified in the article.

data.status: on track to welcome guests later this summer
data.short_description: Novel Social Club is a bar and eatery concept from Thomas and Treshina Brownlee described as "kitchen, cocktails, nightlife," planned for 115 Vance Avenue in Memphis. The 4,487-square-foot establishment is on track to open later this summer, with a certificate of occupancy currently under review with the Memphis and Shelby County Division of Planning and Development. The concept will welcome guests aged 30 to 60 with live music and dishes inspired by Chicago and New Orleans.

data.status: closed on May 31 of this year
data.short_description: WKND Hang Suite was a venue at 115 Vance Avenue in Memphis that closed on May 31, 2026. The space is being taken over by Novel Social Club. No further details about WKND Hang Suite are provided in the article.

Sonic is a fast-casual drive-through restaurant chain that has filed a new construction permit for a planned location at 5541 Poplar Avenue in Memphis, the former site of a Wendy's. The permit, under review as of June 10 with the Memphis and Shelby County Division of Planning and Development, describes a ground-up Sonic drive-thru on a vacant lot spanning 2,194 square feet with an occupant load of 9. Sonic has been in the fast-casual dining industry since 1953 and currently has over 3,000 locations.

Wendy's at 8092 Rockcreek Cove in Cordova is one of two Memphis-area locations purchased by Wendelta, a subsidiary of Carlisle Corp, from Meritage Hospitality Group which intended to shutter them. The location will receive upgraded kitchens, drive-thrus, and brand new dining rooms, with Carlisle Corp. CEO Chance Carlisle estimating it will take eight to twelve months to plan, permit, and rebuild. The stores were saved from closure and will be refurbished rather than shuttered.

Wendy's at 815 N. Germantown Road is one of two Memphis-area locations purchased by Wendelta, a subsidiary of Carlisle Corp, from Meritage Hospitality Group which intended to shutter them. The location will receive upgraded kitchens, drive-thrus, and brand new dining rooms per Carlisle Corp. CEO Chance Carlisle. Carlisle noted it will take approximately eight to twelve months to plan, permit, and rebuild the restaurants.

data.status: currently closed; plans to either refurbish them or demolish them and restart from scratch
data.short_description: Wendy's at 4605 Poplar Avenue in East Memphis is one of two locations purchased by Wendelta from Meritage Hospitality Group and is currently closed. Wendelta plans to either refurbish or demolish and rebuild the location, with Carlisle Corp. CEO Chance Carlisle stating the goal is to turn them into "showcase Wendy's restaurants." The upgraded locations are planned to be customer-ready by summer of 2027.

data.status: currently closed; plans to either refurbish them or demolish them and restart from scratch
data.short_description: Wendy's at 7569 Poplar Avenue in Germantown is one of two locations purchased by Wendelta from Meritage Hospitality Group and is currently closed. Wendelta plans to either refurbish or demolish and rebuild the location, aiming to have both customer-ready by summer of 2027. Carlisle Corp. CEO Chance Carlisle stated the intention is to create showcase Wendy's restaurants that Memphis and Germantown residents would be proud of.

Lilac Coffee is a specialty coffee shop expanding to a third Denver location at Hub North in RiNo. The new lobby and café are expected to open in Fall 2026, with construction commencing in June 2026. New owners Balfour Pacific and Tourmaline Capital Partners announced the expansion alongside a redesigned lobby concept.

data.status: plans remain under review, a timeline has yet to be revealed
data.short_description: Shake Shack is a global burger chain known for its 100% Angus beef burgers, crinkle-cut fries, and frozen custard. The Temecula location will take over the former Union Bank building on Ynez Road, marking the city's first Shake Shack. An opening date has not yet been announced and plans remain under review.

data.location: 535, 555, and 575 Anton Boulevard, Costa Mesa, CA 92626
data.short_description: Oceans & Earth is a Yorba Linda restaurant known for its organic, gluten-free cuisine founded by Chef Adam Navidi. The restaurant is planned to open in 2027 at The MET, a reimagined office campus on Anton Boulevard in Costa Mesa. This will mark the restaurant's first expansion beyond its original Yorba Linda location.

Casalegno's Country Store is a community-focused farm store and coffee shop returning to family ownership under Matt and Marissa Kotila. The store is set to reopen at 3 Laurel Glen Rd, Soquel, with no specific opening date set though the owners hope to welcome guests before the end of summer. The couple operates the adjacent Casalegno Family Farm and plans to offer locally sourced produce, coffee, pastries, and artisan food items.

Bruiser's "The Hot Dog Place" is a hot dog restaurant owned by Kevin and Melissa Barduca, originally opened in Slidell in 2014. The restaurant is preparing to open a new location at 1614 N. Columbia Street in Covington, targeting a summer opening as construction continues. Recent social media posts highlighted inspections and ongoing construction work at the new site.

data.status: opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Gather Cafe and Supper Club is a reservation-only, multi-course dining concept founded by chef Sarah Fragoso, first launched in 2023. The concept is preparing to open a new location at 196 Cohasset Road, Suite 150, in Chico's Garden Villa commercial center, though no opening date has been announced. The reservation-only concept offers seasonally driven menus that change regularly and emphasizes local producers and farm-to-table dining.

data.status: targeting an opening in the coming months
data.short_description: Mavi Turkish Café is a new café concept inspired by Turkish coffee culture, Mediterranean flavors, and traditional hospitality, owned by Emre Sahin and Muhammad Raza. The café is taking over a former Starbucks location at 120 4th Street in downtown San Francisco and is currently in the final stages of build-out, targeting an opening in the coming months. The concept will offer sand-brewed Turkish coffee, traditional pastries such as börek and baklava, and a full specialty coffee program.

data.status: hopes to welcome guests back by the end of [year — article text cut off]
data.short_description: Flann O'Brien's is a beloved neighborhood Irish pub that operated for decades in Mission Hill before closing during the early stages of the pandemic. The revival is being led by local operators Scott Prince, Ray Butler, and Michael Vaughan, who are pursuing a liquor license transfer for the 2,603-square-foot space at 1619 Tremont Street. The space most recently housed Yellow Door Taqueria, which opened in late 2022 and closed earlier in 2026.

Yellow Door Taqueria is a taqueria that operated at 1619 Tremont Street in Mission Hill. It closed earlier in 2026, vacating the space now being pursued by the Flann O'Brien's revival team. The restaurant had opened at this location in late 2022.

data.location: 1870 Harbor Blvd, Suite L2-217, Costa Mesa, CA 92627
data.status: expected to officially open in July
data.short_description: LJ's Lounge is a soul food restaurant and entertainment venue inspired by the owner's mother, debuting at The Triangle Square in Costa Mesa. The concept is expected to officially open in July 2026 at 1870 Harbor Blvd, Suite L2-217, and is currently conducting soft-opening activities. The restaurant is owned by Kenny Jackson (DJ Lil Ken) and is designed to bring a soul food and cultural entertainment experience to Orange County.

data.location: 1716 N University Dr, Suite A, Plantation, FL 33322
data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Potbelly Sandwich Works is a national fast-casual sandwich chain founded in 1977 in Chicago and acquired by RaceTrac in 2025. A new location is planned at 1716 N. University Drive, Suite A in Plantation following a recent permit application filing with the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation. An opening date has not been announced, and the Plantation restaurant is part of the chain's ongoing expansion strategy.

All'Antico Vinaio is a famed Florentine sandwich brand known for oversized sandwiches made on Tuscan flatbread (schiacciata), founded in Florence in 1989 by the Mazzanti family. The restaurant will open a 1,793-square-foot location at 647 Lincoln Road in Miami Beach, marking the company's first location in Florida. A more targeted opening date has not been announced beyond "some time in 2026."

Lyfted Essentials is a cannabis company holding a Conditional Adult Use Retail Dispensary (CAURD) license, planning to open a dispensary in East Harlem. The company is planning to open at 323 E 108th St but has withdrawn its permit application for the June Community Board 11 meeting due to incomplete paperwork, with plans to reapply for the July meeting. No opening date has been announced.

Bass Pro Shops has acquired Cheeca Lodge, a 27-acre oceanfront luxury resort in Islamorada, from Northwood Investors for an undisclosed sum. This is an acquisition/ownership transfer event with no opening, closing, or remodel reported. Northwood Hospitality will continue to manage the 254-room property.

A yet-to-be-named Japanese-American restaurant is planned for the former Au Jus barbecue joint at 1569 Lexington Ave in East Harlem. Owners Enrique Lermo and Anne O'Hare are seeking a full liquor license through a Community Board 11 permit filing, with plans for daily service from noon to midnight and seating for 31 guests. No opening date has been announced.

Air Café is an upscale French-American restaurant planned for the ground floor of the Hotel des Artistes building at 1 W 67th Street on the Upper West Side. Managing partner Max Katzenberg told Community Board 7 that the restaurant will offer à la carte fine dining and retain The Leopard's famed murals by artist Howard Chandler Christy. The Leopard at des Artistes, the prior Italian restaurant at the space, is set to be replaced by Air Café.

The Leopard at des Artistes was an upscale Italian restaurant operating at the ground floor of the Hotel des Artistes building at 1 W 67th Street. It is set to be replaced by Air Café, a French-American concept. No specific closing date is mentioned in the article.

data.status: set to open later this summer
data.short_description: Frye's Famous Crab Cake Co is a crab cake restaurant chain whose titular dish has been voted #1 in the country, with existing locations in Manassas and Ashburn. The Gainesville location at 7524 Iron Bar Lane in Virginia Gateway Shopping Center is set to open later this summer and will span approximately 1,750 square feet with seating for about 50 people. Owner Brandon Frye also plans to franchise the business nationally following this third opening.

data.status: expected to open in the fall of 2026
data.short_description: Lakon Paris Patisserie is a local bakery chain founded in Newton Highlands in 2020, known for specialty croissants, brioche, artisan breads, and decorated cakes. The bakery has announced plans to open a 1,500-square-foot café at 33 Union Street adjoining Harvard Book Store's forthcoming downtown Boston location, marking its fifth Greater Boston location. Both the bakery and bookstore are expected to open in the fall of 2026.

Kai Kai BBQ & Dumplings is a Michelin-recognized Cantonese restaurant currently located inside Mills Market at 1110 East Colonial Drive in Orlando. The restaurant is building on its success with plans to open a new location inside City Center Market's food hall at 1600 Crooked Can Loop in Minneola, under the name "Kai Kai – Norigami." Behind the expansion are founder Jerry and Jackie in partnership with Bento Group, headed by Jimmy and Johnny Tung.

Culver's is a Wisconsin-founded Butterburger and frozen custard chain with nearly 140 Florida locations. Franchisee Bowe Business Group is planning to launch a new Culver's at 5110 Davisson Ave in Orlando, on the southwest corner of the intersection with Lee Road. No opening date has been announced.

data.location: 2980 N Federal Hwy, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33306
data.short_description: Lynora's is a family-owned Italian restaurant chain founded in 1976 by Raffaele and Maria Abbanente, with multiple locations throughout South Florida. The restaurant announced that a location at 2980 N. Federal Highway in Fort Lauderdale would be "coming soon," with no specific opening date announced. The article also notes additional planned locations in Melbourne and Palm Beach Gardens.

The Pit Stop is a deli and sandwich shop serving sub sandwiches, pizza, hot dogs, and other foods. It is opening next month inside the AutoNation Ford dealership at 4911 Wayside Dr in Sanford. The business is owned by entrepreneur Jonathan Vargas, who previously operated a smoke shop and food trucks.

data.status: plans on opening this summer, however there is no exact date
data.short_description: Risica is a new Italian restaurant from chef Andrea Frizzi, set to open on the ground floor of The Edit River North building in Denver's RiNo district. The restaurant will feature a menu with citrus-cured salmon, piadine, grilled skirt steak, and oven-roasted salmon, reflecting a modern take on Italian cuisine. Frizzi also owns Il Posto, which closed in 2024, and Vero.

KoBu Sushi and Omakase is a new restaurant from Chef Tuna, the culinary force behind Ginger Bistro, featuring a la carte dining and an omakase experience with dry-aged fish and Japanese A5 Wagyu. The restaurant opens July 12 in San Marco, where it will include a full dining room, patio, and omakase by reservation only. It will be Chef Tuna's second restaurant and will bring high-end Japanese cuisine to a neighborhood described as currently lacking dedicated sushi options.

data.status: hopes to have open later next month
data.short_description: Fleen's is a pastry and baked goods shop from Chef Kathleen Faliskie, setting up its first brick-and-mortar location at 20937 Ashburn Road Suite 150, where renovations are currently underway. Chef Faliskie hopes to open later next month, offering seating and grab-and-go options with limited hours at launch. The business was previously operated out of rental kitchens with growing custom orders over approximately two years.

Hawkers Asian Street Food is a growing Asian street food chain with 15 locations across states like Florida, Virginia, and Tennessee. A new location is planned for the upcoming Village at Seven Pines development in Jacksonville. The announcement was reported by the Jacksonville Daily Record, alongside other planned concepts including Lynora's and Chipotle.

Bold City BBQ & Seafood is a new food truck concept serving barbecue and more, owned by Alphonso Dawson, who also operates Al's Grills. Plan review paperwork submitted by Bold City BBQ & Seafood LLC shows the food truck based at 2900 N Canal St. in Jacksonville, though the precise service location remains TBA. The owner did not respond to What Now's outreach by time of publication.

data.location: 4970 S Arville St Suite 104, Las Vegas, NV 89118
data.status: anticipated to open in Spring Valley inside the Arville Plaza
data.short_description: Almi's Kitchen is a new restaurant concept expected to open in Spring Valley inside the Arville Plaza at 4970 Arville St, Suite 104, in Las Vegas. It will occupy the space formerly housed by Champagne Kitchen and Lounge, a historic dive bar that formally closed on February 23 of this year. No menu, phone number, hours, website, or social media pages have been publicized.

data.location: 4970 S Arville St Suite 104, Las Vegas, NV 89118
data.status: formally closed its doors on Feb. 23 this year
data.short_description: Champagne Kitchen and Lounge was a historic Las Vegas cocktail and karaoke spot and iconic 1966 Las Vegas dive bar. It formally closed its doors on February 23 due to a combination of the COVID-19 pandemic and prolonged road construction on Maryland Parkway. The space will be taken over by the incoming Almi's Kitchen.

Lynora's is an Italian restaurant chain founded in 1976 in Lake Worth, with a menu featuring entrées such as Beef Short Rib Genovese, Vitello Piccata, and Snapper Lynora, along with pizzas and pastas. A new location is planned for the Village at Seven Pines in the Northeast Florida market, according to reporting by the Jacksonville Daily Record. The chain currently has six locations plus several others marked "Coming Soon," including Melbourne, Delray Beach, Royal Palm Beach, and Fort Lauderdale.

data.location: 11031 Old St Augustine Rd, Jacksonville, FL 32257
data.short_description: Dairy Queen is planning to open a new Grill & Chill restaurant at 11031 Old St. Augustine Rd in Mandarin, which would be the first new Duval County DQ in 9 years. The location would take over a space formerly occupied by Burger King, with JEA reviewing a service availability determination request for the conversion. What Now confirmed the news with franchisee Toks Achebe, though further details are still pending.

data.status: the plan is to open the first Greater Houston Simply South this summer
data.short_description: Simply South is an authentic 100% vegetarian Indian eatery founded in Dallas, Texas in 2024, featuring a menu of more than 450 items celebrating five South Indian states' culinary traditions. Owner Sree Bharat Gummadi confirmed plans to open the first Greater Houston location this summer at 24600 Katy Freeway, Suite 1020 in Katy. The Houston location is already listed as "coming soon" on the Simply South website.

Brick Street Bagels is a local bagelry founded by Jordan Renouf in 2022, offering plain, everything, sesame, rosemary and sea salt, cheddar, and poppy bagels with schmears and breakfast sandwiches, now preparing to open its third location at 160 Charles Street in Boston's Beacon Hill. The new shop will take over the former Savenor's Market space next to The Whitney Hotel and will debut a full bagel, sandwich, and espresso program with expanded seating. The business currently operates two brick-and-mortar locations in the South End and South Boston.

Cafe Mexicali is a fast-casual Mexican restaurant first opened in Fort Collins in 2005, known for fresh, made-from-scratch fare including house-made sauces, meats, beans, and tortillas. The brand is expanding its Colorado footprint with plans to open its first Denver location at 357 S. Bannock Street at AMLI Broadway Park, with a planned 4,013-square-foot buildout including a full kitchen, bar, and 24-seat outdoor patio. Cafe Mexicali currently has six locations across Fort Collins, Greeley, Windsor, Boulder, and Johnstown.

Blazing Bird is a Nashville hot chicken restaurant opened in 2021 by Artem Muradyan, with locations in Denver, Arvada, Englewood, Westminster, and Lakewood. According to a city filing, a new location is planned at 2341 E. Colfax Ave in Denver, though an opening date has not yet been announced. The planned East Colfax restaurant would add to the brand's growing presence across the Front Range.

The Barking Lot is a new bar and dog-friendly dining facility described as a 1,058-square-foot tavern and "dog dining" facility, opening at 946 Main Street in Safety Harbor near the intersection of Main and Delaware Streets. The project received approval from the Safety Harbor City Commission in February, as reported by the Tampa Bay Times. Owner Steven Butler was not available for comment at time of publication, leaving most details TBA beyond the bar setting and leash-free dog zone.

Mother Other is a new vegan restaurant and cocktail bar created by chef Alexi Mandolini and beverage director Taylor Herbert, opening on June 27 at 675 S. Broadway in Denver's Broadway Park. The menu blends Italian, Polish, and Japanese plant-based cuisine, including dishes like Giarancini and spring pea and leek dumplings, with a seasonal cocktail program featuring house-made vegetable sodas. The concept previously operated as a supper club; Mandolini and Herbert also launched The Easy Vegan in 2020.

NADU is a regional Indian restaurant from Michelin-starred chef Sujan Sarkar, preparing to open at Desert Ridge Marketplace at 21001 N. Tatum Blvd. in Phoenix. The upcoming location will be the second for the concept, which debuted in Chicago in 2025 and earned a Michelin Bib Gourmand designation and a James Beard Award semifinalist nomination for Best New Restaurant. Sarkar partnered with Zest Hospitality Group to bring the Arizona location to life.

Medley Kitchen is a new global small-plate restaurant from Columbus chef Derek Bush, set to open this fall in Hilliard's TruePointe development as his first brick-and-mortar under his Culinary Collectives banner. The restaurant will focus on shared ingredients presented in multiple global styles including tapas, dim sum, and mezze, and will initially operate for dinner service only, employing more than 50 staff. Bush brings over 20 years of hospitality experience, including nearly 13 years with Cameron Mitchell Restaurants.

Hudson House is a neighborhood restaurant and raw bar concept operated by Dallas-based Vandelay Hospitality, heading to PV at 4568 E. Cactus Road, Red Development's mixed-use redevelopment of the former Paradise Valley Mall site. The restaurant is expected to open in 2027 and will be the second confirmed Arizona location for the brand, joining a previously announced Gilbert location. Hudson House debuted in 2017 and has expanded throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth area and Houston, known for East Coast seafood, raw bar, and signature cocktails.

Donohue's Steak House is a longstanding steakhouse first established in 1950 in the Upper East Side that has remained in the same family across three generations. The restaurant closed on June 19 after 76 years in business, a decision described by current owner Maureen Donohue-Peters as bittersweet, with the family planning to focus on its Westhampton Beach location. A third location with another niece is also planned on Long Island.

Cock of the Walk is a longtime Nashville Southern comfort food restaurant in a traditional diner-style setting, nestled near the Grand Ole Opry at 2624 Music Valley Drive. The restaurant permanently closed after 42 years of service, serving its last meal on June 17 as the owners retire from the restaurant industry. The closure was announced on Facebook, where the team thanked customers and employees and hinted at a quiet retirement.

Ocean Crab is a new seafood restaurant preparing to open near the Orlando Sanford International Airport. It will open at 2935 S Orlando Drive, replacing the former WingHouse Bar & Grill, with the opening expected next month. The opening was confirmed by a representative of the restaurant on Thursday.

data.location: 9585 SW Washington Square Rd, Portland, OR 97223
data.short_description: Vuori is an activewear brand founded in 2015 by Joe Kudla in Encinitas, California. It is set to open a storefront this summer at Washington Square Mall at 9585 SW Washington Square Rd as part of a broader retail expansion. The Washington Square location will be one of the brand's first in the Portland metro area.

Twin Peaks is a restaurant and bar chain opening its first-ever location in Kissimmee, taking over the former Smokey Bones space at 2911 Vineland Rd in the Poinciana Place shopping center. The company invested $4 million in the conversion, creating an approximately 8,000-square-foot space with two bars and more than 50 TVs. The new location plans to hire 130 people.

Better Buzz Coffee is a craft coffee brand founded in San Diego, California. It is slated to open a new location in Summerlin at 10020 W Sahara Ave towards the end of June, with construction currently underway. The brand was founded by former professional motocross rider Tim Langdon and operates locations across Southern California, Arizona, and Nevada.

data.location: 110 E Lake Mead Pkwy, Henderson, NV
data.short_description: Better Buzz Coffee is a craft coffee brand slated to open a new location in Henderson at 110 E Lake Mead Pkwy later this month. Construction is currently underway at this location. The brand operates locations across Southern California, Arizona, and Nevada.

data.location: 445 E Lake Mead Blvd, North Las Vegas, NV
data.status: slated to open before the end of this year
data.short_description: Better Buzz Coffee is a craft coffee brand planning a third new Las Vegas Valley location in North Las Vegas at 445 E Lake Mead Blvd before the end of this year. This location does not yet have construction underway per the article. The brand was founded in San Diego and has expanded into Arizona and Nevada.

data.status: opening date hasn't been released, but it will be sometime later this summer
data.short_description: Scooter's Coffee is a coffee and tea franchise coming to East Lansing at 3335 E Michigan Avenue, marking the company's first venture in the Lansing area. An opening date has not been released but is expected sometime later this summer. The new location is being debuted by franchisees Michael Endres and Bryan Bender, with Endres being a Michigan State alumnus.

Colletta is an Italian restaurant concept by The Indigo Road Hospitality, born in Alpharetta, Georgia. It is opening a new outpost within the Hotel Merrydelle, the redevelopment of the historic 1924 Ambassador Hotel at 310 West Church Street in downtown Jacksonville, expected to open in late 2027. The project is described as Downtown Jacksonville's first lifestyle hotel.

data.location: 1631 S Melrose Drive, Suite A, Vista, CA
data.short_description: Ross Dress for Less is a national off-price retail chain that has submitted documents to San Diego County for a new store in Vista at 1631 S Melrose Drive, Suite A, which would replace a CVS Pharmacy at Melrose Village Plaza. The project is currently pending consults. Ross is the largest off-price retailer in the United States.

Ross Dress for Less has filed plans for a second new San Diego-area location in Lakeside at 9532 Winter Gardens Boulevard, which would take over a former Rite Aid space. The project is currently pending consults. Ross targets high-traffic shopping centers and has numerous existing locations throughout San Diego County.

DD's Discounts is a subsidiary brand of Ross Stores that has filed plans for a new location at 1854 Coronado Avenue, replacing a former Rite Aid location. The project is currently pending consults. DD's Discounts follows a similar off-price model to Ross but focuses on a more budget-oriented selection of apparel and home goods.

data.location: 17401 Ventura Blvd, Suite G, Encino, CA 91316
data.status: looking into the space but nothing is definite as of yet
data.short_description: Dojo Sushi is a Sherman Oaks-based sushi restaurant that has been part of the Sherman Oaks community for more than a decade serving authentic sushi. It is eyeing expansion to Encino Courtyard at 17401 Ventura Blvd, Suite G, according to an ABC filing, though the owner shared nothing is definite as of yet. Further details are forthcoming in the coming months.

data.location: 550 Wells Rd, Suite 1, Orange Park, FL
data.short_description: Brunch Box is a new mobile food vendor created by Pamela Dallas, the local business owner behind Skin Unlimited, LE & Body Sculpting Services. Plan review documents place the food truck home base at 550 Wells Rd, Suite 1, in Orange Park, but it is not yet known exactly where or when the food truck will set up shop. Dallas was not immediately available for comment at time of publication.

data.location: Corner of Sixth Avenue and Upas Street, Bankers Hill, San Diego, CA
data.short_description: Mary's Gourmet Salads is a San Diego-based fast casual restaurant specializing in made-to-order salads, soups, and healthy fare. Its third location is set to open in Bankers Hill at the corner of Sixth Avenue and Upas Street in the Park Summit building, with no exact opening date yet announced. The expansion will bring the brand beyond its existing locations in La Jolla and Ocean Beach.

data.status: signs nonetheless point to the project moving forward
data.short_description: Casa Vive is a new yoga studio and wellness concept planned for Jacksonville at 1520 Prudential Drive. It recently received a permit for a $150,000 build-out, with contractor 8720 Cleaning Services LLC heading up the work; the studio was originally expecting a spring opening. Casa Vive is headed up by Lululemon ambassador Alejandra Amegin.

data.location: 6324 E Pacific Coast Hwy, Long Beach, CA 90803
data.status: expects to open by the end of summer
data.short_description: IYKYK! Coffee Lab is an Orange County-based coffee brand opening a location in Long Beach at Marina Pacifica Shopping Center at 6324 E. Pacific Coast Highway. The team expects to open by the end of summer, and the Long Beach location will feature the brand's newest design prototype, the Joyride Coffee Lounge, with a vinyl listening room and outdoor patio. IYKYK! opened its first coffee lab in 2024 in Huntington Beach and later expanded to Costa Mesa.

data.location: 50 Place du Commerce, Magog, QC J1X 5G6, Canada
data.status: expects to be fully operational by July 1, 2026
data.short_description: La Buvette Shiso is a new restaurant and wine bar concept opening in downtown Magog at 50 Place du Commerce, moving into the former home of Méli Smoked Meat. The project is led by Benjamin Pen, Charles Massicolli, and Dana Blumer, and the team is currently operating a soft opening while awaiting its liquor permit, expecting to be fully operational by July 1, 2026. The menu is centered on pasta, fish, vegetables, wine, cocktails, and Quebec beers, with dishes sourced from local farms and rotating seasonally.

data.location: 406 W Belt Line Rd, Cedar Hill, TX 75104
data.short_description: Mija Barbecue is a family-owned barbecue restaurant in Cedar Hill, Texas that began as a backyard barbecue project before growing into a brick-and-mortar business. The owners announced through social media that the restaurant will close on June 27, 2026, without providing a specific reason for the closure. The restaurant moved into its brick-and-mortar home in 2024, transforming a historic 1938 house, and was founded by husband and wife duo Ryan and Bailey Siegler.

Crackin Blue Crabs is an upcoming food truck promising "All Flavor No Flex" in the Jacksonville area, with plan review paperwork submitted by Crackin Blue Crabs LLC. No opening timeline has been confirmed, with the brand only indicating "coming soon" on social media. Co-owner Latasha Armstrong was not immediately available for comment at time of publication.

Sheep is a new rooftop dining concept planned by Id Est Hospitality Group founder Kelly Whitaker, set to debut this summer on the sixth-floor rooftop of the Clayton Hotel & Members Club at 233 Clayton Street in Cherry Creek, Denver. It will be a three-month residency running July to October, offering a nightly four-course menu. Whitaker is also co-owner of The Wolf's Tailor, which last year became Colorado's first restaurant to earn two Michelin stars.

McDonald's is preparing to open a new location in Magog on Rue Sherbrooke, across from Walmart, expected to open in Fall 2026, with construction already underway on the vacant site. Franchise owner Caroline Iannuzzi, who operates seven existing McDonald's restaurants across the Estrie region, will oversee the new restaurant. The new location will feature a design similar to the recently opened McDonald's in Sherbrooke's Quartier Santé district, with an emphasis on takeout, mobile ordering, and drive-thru service.

Gringos Tacos is an upcoming food truck serving Flagler County with a menu featuring birria tacos and ramen, with plan review paperwork recently submitted by Dos Bros Foods LLC. No opening date has been confirmed, as Chef Chris Gibbs was not immediately available for comment. Facebook posts indicate the food truck is currently being built and is about to launch.

Planet Fitness has opened a new 21,141-square-foot fitness center in Sammamish at 3066 228th Avenue SE, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony scheduled for June 18, 2026. The location is the brand's 19th in the Seattle-Tacoma area and features 83 strength-training machines, 56 cardio machines, a cross-training area, and additional amenities for Black Card members. The facility is operated by CDM Fitness Holdings, one of the largest Planet Fitness franchisees.

Palazzo Pizza Italiana is a new pizza restaurant headed up by Jason Fox and the team at Josephine's Italian Market, set to open at 214 E Cass St in Downtown Tampa. The space features a moody interior with a room-length bar and large semi-circular booths, with menu details still under wraps. A previous instantiation of Palazzo Pizza was located on West Platt Street and was active until May 2024.

data.location: 17553 Kedzie Avenue Suite 22-24, Hazel Crest, IL 60429
data.short_description: Dream's Pizza is a Chicago-style pizza chain with locations in the south suburbs, offering build-your-own pizzas, pastas, and salads. The chain will be joining the Hazel Crest Center at 17553 Kedzie Avenue Suite 22-24 later this year, with the owner stating he does not yet have an exact opening date. Owner Mickey Banks has been planning three locations since debuting his first spot in Markham, and may close the Markham location once the Hazel Crest spot opens.

data.status: construction is expected to begin on July 1 and could wrap up by October 31
data.short_description: Little Red Barn Market is a local market and bakery concept that has operated as a pop-up stand in the Burnet area. According to public filings, the concept could remodel an existing 912-square-foot building at 103 S. Silver Street in downtown Burnet, with construction expected to begin July 1 and wrap up by October 31. The concept is connected to a self-serve outdoor stand started by Sarah Files and a group of neighbor partners.

Bar Noto is an aperitivo bar concept serving natural wine, non-alcoholic wine, and beer paired with light bites like chips, olives, and cheese. Owner Gloria Noto confirmed to What Now Portland that the bar is set to open mid-July at 1932 NW Lovejoy Street in Portland's Alphabet District, with hours wrapping up at 7pm. A liquor license application has been filed with the Portland Police Bureau's Liquor License Division listing the business as Bar Noto.

data.location: 3515 S. Preston Road, Suite 130, Celina, TX 75009
data.status: construction scheduled for completion by the end of December 2026
data.short_description: Luna Grill Mediterranean Kitchen is a Mediterranean fast-casual chain founded in San Diego, known for grilled kabobs, fresh salads, bowls, pita wraps, and house-made hummus. According to public filings, the chain could open at 3515 S. Preston Road, Suite 130, in Celina, occupying a 2,183-square-foot space with construction scheduled for completion by the end of December 2026. Luna Grill expanded into Texas in 2018 and currently has multiple DFW locations, with a Forney outpost also potentially in the works.
